title: Research is refused at every entry point unless the project chose Tavily and this computer granted it
statement: Each research entry point - the research_capability, research_search and research_fetch tools Kiln registers in Pi, research:search and research:record (bin/research.mjs), and research:probe (bin/research-probe.mjs) - refuses unless the project's committed research choice is tavily AND this computer holds a standing research grant for it, read from where the run keeps its runtime state: project-local, or the per-user root setup keeps with --local-state user. The refusal happens before TAVILY_API_KEY is read and before any request is made, and it names a stable reason: no project context, the project record unreadable, research not chosen, this computer's consent record unreadable, no standing grant, or a local-state mode that is neither project nor user. An unreadable record of either kind refuses; it is never read as permission. The context is explicit: Pi receives the project root and state mode from the supervisor, and the commands require --project-root and take --local-state; nothing is guessed from the working directory. research:record additionally refuses, before fetching, when its evidence destination (the content-root rule or PLANNING_CONTENT_DIR) belongs to a project other than the one whose consent was read. When research is not permitted at launch, TAVILY_API_KEY is kept out of the environment of both of the supervisor's children. Each refusal reason is shown at each entry point by a test that also shows no key was read and no request was made, and the permitted cases, project-local and per-user, are shown to reach the key only after the gate.
